data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 factsheet summarizes how 15-year-old students in Baku (Azerbaijan) performed in mathematics, reading, and science, and how results changed relative to 2018. It reports that average performance declined in all three domains from 2018 to 2022, and that the gap between top and bottom deciles widened in reading and science but not in mathematics. In 2022, 38% of students reached at least Level 2 in mathematics (OECD average: 69%), 31% reached Level 2 or higher in reading (OECD average: 74%), and 34% reached Level 2 or higher in science (OECD average: 76%). The factsheet also highlights within-Baku disparities by socioeconomic status (ESCS), gender differences (girls higher in mathematics and reading), and aspects of school climate and parental involvement. It is descriptive and does not estimate an ML model; uncertainty intervals and asterisks for sampling-standard issues are used to guide interpretation.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This is an OECD PISA results factsheet rather than an empirical research article estimating predictive models.
